ns2:course.label: Sustainability & Manufacturing
ns2:course.description: Exploration of environmental origins, theory and practice of sustainable product design. Environmentally-responsive design methodologies and topics such as industrial ecology, dematerialization, design for disassembly, design for recycling and life-cycle assessment. Additional fees may apply. See Class Schedule. Prerequisite: Junior standing in Art and Design or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Additional fees may apply. See Class Schedule. Prerequisite: Junior standing in Art and Design or consent of instructor.
